title: Headship: "Head" in Paul
lead: Paul calls Christ the "head" of the church and the husband the "head" of the wife (Ephesians 1:22; 4:15; 5:23; 1 Corinthians 11:3; Colossians 1:18). Whether the Greek word means authority, source or prominence is debated, and the answer shapes churches' teaching on marriage and on women in ministry.
